categories_thin: Mental health / therapy: Monroe has many solo LCSW/LPC/LSW practitioners listed only on Psychology Today and Zencare (individual profiles, often home or shared-suite addresses). Only group providers (Center for Wellness, JFS Monroe) are listed; solo clinicians were deliberately not enumerated one by one.

Wellness / alternative care (acupuncture, massage, reiki, nutrition): still thin. Acupuncture surfaced only three Monroe addresses (two in this list plus an NPI-only practitioner at 1989 Englishtown Rd), and massage is represented mainly by spa listings and one Wellness.com therapist profile; most leads are single-directory entries or appear home-based.

Personal care beyond hair/nails (esthetics, lash, brow, waxing): searched again during revision. Monroe brow/lash work appears to happen inside hair salons (Lenneth Miller, J & B, Bliss threading) rather than as standalone studios; the only standalone lash/brow listing was Bbrows at a residential address. The sub-category looks genuinely small, not just under-searched.
Hearing / audiology: only two Monroe addresses surfaced; the multi-office NJ hearing-aid chain was dropped as a chain, leaving one independent practice.
caveats: Distance checks were run on every address the verifier flagged, using the US Census geocoder (address-range coordinates) and OpenStreetMap Nominatim, measured straight-line from central Milltown (approx. 40.4498, -74.4407). Results: 1989 Englishtown Rd ~8.2 mi (kept); 891/893 Cranbury-South River Rd ~5.0 mi (kept); 557 Englishtown Rd ~9.7 mi (kept, near the edge); 627 Spotswood-Englishtown Rd ~8.7 mi (kept); 981 and 957 NJ-33 ~12.7 mi (CUT - outside the radius).

Cut for distance (three entries): Dandelion Beauty Spa (981 NJ-33), Inner Warrior Martial Arts (957 NJ-33 W) and Caravaglio Self Defense & Training Center (957 NJ-33 W). The Route 33 corridor south of the township centre is roughly 12.7 mi from Milltown, so the earlier 'confirm within 10 mi' notes resolved against keeping them.

Chains / franchise positions decided for this revision: Total Hearing Care (multi-office NJ hearing-aid retailer) and Legends ATA Martial Arts (ATA-branded taekwondo affiliation) were dropped. Kept with a recorded chain caveat: Bliss Beauty Salon (several NJ salons, small local operator), Dental Care of Monroe (part of a 10-office South Jersey group), New Jersey Oral & Facial Surgery and Princeton Eye Group (multi-office professional groups). Advocare Mid-Jersey Pediatrics was found but excluded as part of a large statewide physician network.

Several entries rest on a single bulk directory or map listing (noted in active_evidence) and need a liveness check - typical for older Yellow Pages, SuperPages, NPI, Loc8NearMe and LocalityBiz records. Those with no independent confirmation at all are marked 'verify before outreach' in notes.

Overlook Dr addresses sit on the Monroe/Jamesburg boundary: the US Census geocoder returned no match for 100 Overlook Dr under Monroe Township 08831, and Bing labels it Jamesburg, so that entry's town label is unresolved. 100 Overlook Dr is also shared by a dental listing and Blitz Chiropractic; suite numbers are unverified.

No Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, Cylex or Chamber of Commerce bulk directory page could be opened directly (Cloudflare 403 on yellowpages.com, chamberofcommerce.com and cylex.us.com; BBB search returned national results), so completeness rests on search-engine plus map-listing aggregation rather than one authoritative local directory.
Both corrected beauty entries lost their website: sl-haus.com and salon527nj.com no longer serve those businesses.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API timed out from this environment, so no OSM cross-check of the whole zone was possible; Nominatim geocoding was usable for individual addresses only.
Monroe Township's official site has no searchable business directory; only a senior-services PDF and newsletters mention providers, and no licensed-business or economic-development list was found.
Psychology Today, Zencare and similar therapist directories were not paged through exhaustively, so dozens of solo mental-health practitioners in 08831 are not itemized.
Bing Maps returned only the top few results per query without sign-in; deeper pagination would likely surface additional salons, nail bars and small offices.
LocalityBiz listing pages returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch, so the two entries sourced to them (Oriental Wellness, Bbrows) rest on search-result summaries of those pages and need field verification.
No phone verification was possible (read-only research), so the several 'listings disagree on the number' cases (SL Haus, A Healing Touch, Nail'd It, Oriental Wellness) are unresolved.
Many entries have no website recorded because none was seen linked from a listing; the triage team should look these up.
